title: Melting Clock Phoenix
description: A vibrant, multicolored phoenix with a glowing trail of pink, yellow, green, and purple light rises from a shattered, melting clock face. The transparent glass clock sphere features Roman numerals, crescent moons, and dripping golden liquid, mounted on a brass and black pedestal against a dramatic cloudy sky with light rays.
prompt: A luminous phoenix composed of flowing rainbow energy in pink, yellow, green and purple rises upward from the center of a large cracked transparent spherical clock. The clock face has Roman numerals and crescent moons, with sections melting and dripping like liquid gold. The sphere is mounted on an elegant brass pedestal. Dramatic volumetric light rays pierce through dark purple clouds in the background, with colorful light streaks on the ground, in a surreal dreamlike atmosphere.
